content.title: How to watch Celtics vs. Knicks NBA game tonight on Prime: Start time, free live stream
content.text: New York Knicks' OG Anunoby, left, defends Boston Celtics' Jayson Tatum (0) during the second half of Game 4 in the Eastern Conference semifinals of the NBA basketball playoffs Monday, May 12, 2025, in New York.(AP Photo/Frank Franklin II)If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe New York Knicks continue their bid for Eastern Conference playoff positioning Thursday night at Madison Square Garden with a visit from the Boston Celtics. The game is scheduled to start at 7:30 p.m. ET with streaming exclusively on Amazon Prime.How to watch: The Celtics vs. Knicks matchup will be carried live on Prime Video, which comes with a 30-day free trial for new users.Boston Celtics (54-25) at New York Knicks (51-28)NBA matchup at a glanceWhen: Thursday, April 9 at 7:30 p.m. ETWhere: Madison Square Garden, New York, N.Y.TV channel: N/ALive stream: Amazon Prime exclusive (free trial)The Knicks currently sit in the No. 3 spot in the East with their 51-28 record and three games separating them from the second-place Celtics. Perhaps more importantly, the Knicks are a half-game ahead of the fourth-place Cleveland Cavaliers and seek to fortify their position to maintain that spot. Boston is mathematically within reach, particularly with a win Thursday night, but plenty more would have to go the Knicks’ way to make that leap. The Detroit Pistons are 58-22 and have already clinched the No. 1 seed in the East.The Knicks are listed as 5.5-point betting favorites entering Thursday’s contest on a run of three straight wins, most recently beating the Atlanta Hawks (108-105) on the road Monday night. The Celtics have won four straight and seven of their past eight as the 1-2 punch of Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum start to fire on all cylinders for a potential championship run.The Knicks and Celtics are set for a 7:30 p.m. ET start exclusively on Prime Video, which comes with a free trial.
